resources.string: At DroidKaigi, we also host events beyond the sessions for participants to enjoy. Take the opportunity to connect, share ideas, and fully experience the conference!
Collect stamps and exchange them for prizes!

This year as well we have prepared a stamp rally for your enjoyment! Stamps can be collected at each booth in the Exhibition Area. You can receive up to four amazing DroidKaigi original prizes, depending on how many stamps you collect. We look forward to your participation!
